scope: Unified held-out DROID episodes 21/77 SVO calibration and depth lineage
summary: A single frozen-runtime acceptance run completed all six real cameras for lineage-mapped episodes 21 and 77 with sensor-derived metric depth and exact artifact provenance.
evidence: The unified run completed on physical GPU 5 in 8.54 seconds with both episode return codes equal to zero.
Episode 21 has three 1280x720 cameras with 92 frames; episode 77 has three 1280x720 cameras with 100 frames.
All reported camera serials match the raw DROID metadata.
Episode-21 depth finite fractions span 0.1420 to 0.6837; episode-77 fractions span 0.4789 to 0.7539.
Every calibration.json records lineage_mapped_to_lerobot=true, explicit episode index, raw prefix, exterior assignment, SVO hashes, intrinsics, distortion, timestamps, and depth-artifact hashes.
lessons: The reproducible runtime is RLinf Python/NumPy plus the isolated ZED 5.1 site-packages with LC_ALL=C.
Lineage, calibration, rights, and timestamp alignment remain separate gates.
limitations: Episode 60 has no public raw tree and remains blocked.
Official raw DROID rights and raw-HDF5-to-LeRobot video/action timestamp offset remain unresolved.
Calibration does not establish novel-view generation quality.
next_actions: Audit raw HDF5/image timestamp alignment for episodes 21 and 77.
Use explicit episode-local exterior assignments in depth-warp and geometry-conditioned validation.
